messages.document.title: PE Viewer
messages.toolbar.reload.title: Reload the file from disk
messages.copy.title: Click to copy
messages.empty.noImports: No import table (statically linked, or resolved another way).
messages.state.detailsMissing: No version-info, manifest, debug, or Rich-header data found in this binary.
messages.state.noFile: No file open. Open an .exe, .dll, .sys, .ocx or .scr file to inspect it here.
messages.note.highEntropy: A high-entropy executable section was detected; the binary may be packed or encrypted.
messages.note.imports: {libraries} libraries, {symbols} imported symbols. Click a library to expand.
messages.note.certificateNames: Common names scanned from the certificate blob, usually the publisher plus the CA chain. This is not a cryptographic validity check.
messages.note.hashes: Click a value to copy. Imphash fingerprints the import table (used to group related binaries); MD5 and SHA are over the whole file. Full-file MD5 is skipped for very large files to keep the viewer responsive; SHA-256 still covers integrity checks.
messages.note.richHeader: Undocumented Microsoft toolchain markers (linker/compiler product and build IDs). XOR key {key}.
